acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Slimes family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Primordial Ooze, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Multicore Tide Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Near-liquid titan with a dozen cores, absorbed weapons and armor suggesting a face, and a tide of lesser slimes at its base.

Signature mechanic: Arena Transformation — Twelve-Core Tide: four cores enter each basin and command Droplet hops, Blob rolls, or Ooze Knight crust walls; clearing the announced pattern exposes that basin's lead core and permanently lowers its tide.
battlefieldDuty: Transform the arena into three moving tide basins while delegating distinct core patterns to lesser slimes.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and streamline around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores in separated pressure lobes.
Directional membrane ridges, debris streamers, vapor channels, flattened leading edges, and a still pocket behind the core show coherent pressure flow.
counterplay: Answer the called lower-form pattern, then strike the aligned lead core; each broken lead core drains one basin and removes that command set. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and reveal one still core; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint when flow reverses; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores when a pressure lobe collapses.
identityInvariants: Rounded, drooping, gravity-obeying jelly with surface-tension edges and a readable internal core remains the family silhouette.
Translucent blue, acid green, amber, or violet is chosen per individual, with suspended debris and a brighter but bounded core.
Viscous flow, drip trails, swallowed objects, crystalline cores, and later crust plates remain spatially coherent.
Internal structure emerges by tier: pseudopod, debris-bearing blob, humanoid crust frame, suspended skeleton, then a multicore tide.
telegraph: Absorbed weapons form a face toward one basin while four of the dozen cores align beneath it and its tide rises.
